CustomField.description: Full name of the custom Lightning web component shown when Component Type is Lightning Web Component, for example c:myCustomWidget or namespace:componentName. The component receives the Form Submission through public (@api) record and objectApiName properties, and can send formfieldchange events so its values feed the form's merge fields.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the fully qualified name of the custom Lightning Web Component to render, like c:myCustomWidget. The component must implement @api record and @api objectApiName; set Component Type to Lightning Web Component for it to display.
CustomField.label: LWC Component Name
